import pandas as pd


def revenue_per_user(rows):
    if len(rows) == 0:
        return []
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    grouped = frame.groupby("user_id")["revenue"].sum().reset_index()
    grouped = grouped.sort_values(by=["revenue", "user_id"], ascending=[False, True])
    out = []
    for record in grouped.to_dict(orient="records"):
        out.append({"user_id": str(record["user_id"]),
                    "revenue": round(float(record["revenue"]), 2)})
    return out
